newsitem.title: USA: Reuters launches new Web page.
newsitem.headline: Reuters launches new Web page.

text.p: Reuters America Inc said on Wednesday it launched a new World Wide Web page on the Internet to provide news, market research and other information for the media industry.
The page -- called Media World, or www.mediaworld.com -- is geared to the media and advertising industry, particular the buyers and sellers of advertising, a company spokeswoman said.

Media World users can access industry news feeds from the Reuters news service, explore media markets and order market profiles from data providers, such as Arbitron, Competitrack, Media Market Resources, Scarborough Research, Simmons, SQAD, SRDS and Strategic Media Research.

"Media World gives media professionals the information they need to make smart decisions as they buy and sell media in a constantly changing market," Reuters Marketing Information Executive Vice President Alexander Hungate said in a statement.
